def simulate_snake(board_size, snake, food, moves):
    width, height = board_size
    # Make copies to avoid mutating input lists
    snake = list(snake)
    food = list(food)
    
    # Helper to get the current direction of the snake
    # Direction is from snake[1] to snake[0]
    def get_current_direction(s):
        if len(s) < 2:
            return None
        hx, hy = s[0]
        nx, ny = s[1]
        if hx > nx: return "RIGHT"
        if hx < nx: return "LEFT"
        if hy > ny: return "DOWN"
        if hy < ny: return "UP"
        return None

    opposites = {
        "UP": "DOWN",
        "DOWN": "UP",
        "LEFT": "RIGHT",
        "RIGHT": "LEFT"
    }

    food_eaten = 0
    alive = True
    just_ate = False

    for move in moves:
        if not alive:
            break

        current_dir = get_current_direction(snake)
        
        # If the move direction is opposite to the current direction, 
        # continue in the current direction.
        if current_dir and move == opposites.get(current_dir):
            actual_move = current_dir
        else:
            actual_move = move

        # Calculate new head position
        hx, hy = snake[0]
        if actual_move == "UP":
            new_head = (hx, hy - 1)
        elif actual_move == "DOWN":
            new_head = (hx, hy + 1)
        elif actual_move == "LEFT":
            new_head = (hx - 1, hy)
        elif actual_move == "RIGHT":
            new_head = (hx + 1, hy)
        else:
            new_head = (hx, hy)

        # Check boundaries
        nx, ny = new_head
        if not (0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height):
            alive = False
            break

        # Check self-collision
        # The snake can legally move into the spot currently occupied by its tail 
        # (unless it just ate and the tail is staying put, but even then, tail collision 
        # rules usually exclude the tail. The prompt states: "touches any part of the 
        # snake's own body (other than the tail square it is about to move)").
        body_to_check = snake[:-1] if not just_ate else snake
        if new_head in body_to_check:
            alive = False
            break

        # Move snake: insert new head
        snake.insert(0, new_head)

        # Check food consumption
        active_food = food[0] if food else None
        if active_food and new_head == active_food:
            food_eaten += 1
            food.pop(0)  # Next food becomes active
            just_ate = True
        else:
            if not just_ate:
                snake.pop()  # Remove tail if didn't eat
            just_ate = False

    return (snake, alive, food_eaten)
